questions.question: Which manager guided Leicester City to their first-ever FA Cup triumph in May 2021, defeating Chelsea 1–0 in the final at Wembley Stadium?
questions.explanation: Brendan Rodgers led Leicester City to FA Cup glory courtesy of Youri Tielemans' memorable 30-yard strike in the second half.
questions.anchorClues: Brendan Rodgers / Leicester City FA Cup 2021

questions.question: True or False: Hull City led Arsenal 2–0 within the first eight minutes of the 2014 FA Cup Final before Arsenal fought back to win 3–2 in extra time.
questions.explanation: James Chester and Curtis Davies scored early goals for Steve Bruce's Hull City before Arsenal staged a famous comeback sealed by Aaron Ramsey's extra-time winner.
questions.anchorClues: Hull City vs Arsenal 2014 FA Cup Final

questions.question: Which historic stadium served as Manchester City's home ground for 80 years from 1923 until their relocation in 2003?
questions.explanation: Maine Road hosted Manchester City matches for eight decades before the club moved to the City of Manchester Stadium following the 2002 Commonwealth Games.
questions.anchorClues: Maine Road / Manchester City home ground

questions.question: What was the final scoreline when Middlesbrough recorded a stunning victory over Sven-Göran Eriksson's Manchester City on the final day of the 2007–08 season?
questions.explanation: Afonso Alves scored a hat-trick at the Riverside Stadium as Gareth Southgate's Middlesbrough routed ten-man Manchester City 8–1.

questions.question: True or False: Tottenham Hotspur were the first team in Premier League history to qualify for the UEFA Champions League despite ending the season with a negative goal difference.
questions.explanation: Everton achieved this distinction in 2004–05, finishing 4th under David Moyes with a -1 goal difference (45 goals scored, 46 conceded). Tottenham finished 4th in 2009–10 with a +26 goal difference.

questions.question: Which English manager led newly promoted Reading to an 8th-place Premier League finish in the 2006–07 season, accumulating 55 points in their debut top-flight campaign?
questions.explanation: Steve Coppell oversaw a remarkable 2006–07 season at the Madejski Stadium, taking Reading to 8th place and narrowly missing out on European qualification.

questions.question: Which squad number was worn by South Korean forward Son Heung-min throughout his prolific career at Tottenham Hotspur, winning the Premier League Golden Boot while wearing it?
questions.explanation: Son Heung-min wore the number 7 shirt at Tottenham Hotspur, scoring over 100 Premier League goals for the North London club.

questions.question: Which Spanish forward scored 18 goals in all competitions for Swansea City during a sensational 2012–13 debut season after signing from Rayo Vallecano for £2 million?
questions.explanation: Michu took the Premier League by storm in 2012–13 under Michael Laudrup, helping Swansea City win the League Cup and secure a top-half finish.

questions.question: Which club set the Premier League record for the most consecutive home victories, winning 24 straight league matches at home between February 2019 and July 2020?
questions.explanation: Jürgen Klopp's Liverpool won 24 consecutive league fixtures at Anfield across two seasons, breaking Manchester City's previous record of 20 straight home wins.

questions.question: Which French manager served as Fulham boss from 2000 to 2003, guiding the West London club into the Premier League top flight and lifting the UEFA Intertoto Cup in 2002?
questions.explanation: Jean Tigana managed Fulham between 2000 and 2003, introducing stylish passing football to Craven Cottage and securing European qualification.
